headline: Ohio Northern completes an unbeaten OAC season
dek: Ohio Northern won seven matches and drew two without a defeat, scoring 23 goals while conceding only five across all matches. Every other OAC program absorbed multiple losses, leaving Ohio Northern alone at the end of the campaign without a blemish.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Mount Union's 51 goals exceed the combined totals of Marietta, Heidelberg, and Muskingum, showing a wide scoring gap between the conference's top attack and its lowest-scoring programs.

wire.line: Heidelberg finished winless with five draws and twelve losses, conceding 43 goals across the season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mount Union midfielder Dom Kustura recorded ten goals and ten assists on 42 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Heidelberg goalkeeper Xochiel Galvan made 103 saves and allowed 42 goals, finishing with a 0.71 save percentage.

last_match.line: Ohio Northern closed out an unbeaten campaign; Baldwin Wallace arrived after winning at Mount Union.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
